description: This file contains functions for manipulating socket address structures (sockaddr), including retrieving port numbers, comparing addresses, converting to/from string representations, and resolving hostnames. It is specific to socket address handling in a network server context, particularly for the lighttpd web server project.

methods.name: unsigned short sock_addr_get_port(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Returns the port number from the sockaddr structure, handling IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_addr_wildcard(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Checks if the sockaddr address is a wildcard address (INADDR_ANY for IPv4, in6addr_any for IPv6).

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_family_eq(const sock_addr * saddr1,const sock_addr * saddr2)
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr structures have the same address family.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_port_eq(const sock_addr * saddr1,const sock_addr * saddr2)
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr structures have the same port number, considering address family.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_addr_eq(const sock_addr * saddr1,const sock_addr * saddr2)
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr structures have the same address, considering address family.

methods.name: int sock_addr_is_addr_eq_bits(const sock_addr * a,const sock_addr * b,int bits)
methods.description: Checks if two sockaddr addresses are equal up to a certain number of bits (subnet comparison).

methods.name: void sock_addr_set_port(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,const unsigned short port)
methods.description: Sets the port number of a sockaddr structure.

methods.name: int sock_addr_assign(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,int family,unsigned short nport,const void * const restrict naddr)
methods.description: Assigns address and port to a sockaddr structure based on family.

methods.name: int sock_addr_inet_pton(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,const char * const restrict str,int family,unsigned short port)
methods.description: Converts a string IP address to sockaddr format for IPv4 or IPv6, setting port.

methods.name: const char * sock_addr_inet_ntop(const sock_addr * const restrict saddr,char * const restrict buf,socklen_t sz)
methods.description: Converts a sockaddr address to its string representation.

methods.name: int sock_addr_inet_ntop_copy_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr)
methods.description: Copies the string representation of sockaddr to a buffer.

methods.name: int sock_addr_inet_ntop_append_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr)
methods.description: Appends the string representation of sockaddr to a buffer.

methods.name: int sock_addr_stringify_append_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr)
methods.description: Appends a stringified version of sockaddr (including port) to a buffer.

methods.name: int sock_addr_nameinfo_append_buffer(buffer * const restrict b,const sock_addr * const restrict saddr,log_error_st * const restrict errh)
methods.description: Appends hostname information for sockaddr to a buffer, doing DNS lookup.

methods.name: int sock_addr_from_str_hints(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,socklen_t * const restrict len,const char * const restrict str,int family,unsigned short port,log_error_st * const restrict errh)
methods.description: Resolves a string address to sockaddr, with hints for family and port, handling hostname resolution.

methods.name: int sock_addr_from_str_numeric(sock_addr * const restrict saddr,const char * const restrict str,log_error_st * const restrict errh)
methods.description: Parses a numeric IP address string directly into sockaddr without hostname resolution.
